data.name: Glanville
data.gender_notes: Glanville is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name of Old English origin, derived from the words 'clan' meaning 'family' and 'wyl' meaning 'will'. It symbolizes the strong connection and loyalty between family members and their shared desires. The name Glanville carries the meaning “Will of the family” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Glanville usually hope their child will grow to embody will of the family and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name representing the unity and strength of family ties.

in_english.name: Glanville
in_english.long_meaning: The name Glanville is derived from the Old English words 'glan' meaning smooth or clear, and 'wylle' meaning valley or pool. Thus, Glanville can be translated as 'valley of the smooth stones'.

It is believed that the use of compounds in names reveals a genuine concern for relationships, especially within the family structure. These days, the name has a sense of dignity and nobility, as it is an old, well-established name that has withstood the test of time.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Glanville also carries spiritual importance, as the Old English word 'wyl' (will) can be seen as a reflection of God's will for our lives. This name serves as a reminder that our deepest desires and goals are in alignment with God's plan for us. In Christian theology, God's will is perfect, even when it may not seem so from our human perspective. So, the name Glanville can be seen as a reminder to seek God's will in all things and to trust that His plan will ultimately bring us closer to our true desires and goals, within our family and in our spiritual journeys.
